source: Claremont Competitors Programming 12–18 Oct 26; CFC Fortnightly Fulls WL block wk 1/9; CFC Endurance
focus: First week back after flu + pneumonia: class metcons at 60–70%
decisions: Updated Wed 14 Oct. Monday: only 1 set of back squat (out of time), and the WL class was missed. Tuesday: POLP back squat redone as the full row, 10/10/9 @ 140, logged as a FAIL so the workbook repeats 140. Bench was missed Tuesday and the WL session Wednesday AM.

Rest of the week: the POLP deadlift moves to Wed PM Performance (part A). Row S1 moves to Thu AM. Bench moves to Fri before the run. Press goes to Sun open gym, so it isn't the day after Thursday's strict HSPU. Monday's and Wednesday morning's WL sessions are dropped, not made up.
Illness week: every class metcon is CRUISE at 60–70% (Jason's own Mon/Wed advice). Thursday comp class and the Saturday Performance chipper are skipped.
POLP rows are exactly as the workbook has them. Back squat 3×10 @ 140 is a big step, and stopping a set short is a logged FAIL that the workbook repeats.
Monday back squat goes in the WL session after the snatch work, so the snatches are fresh. Monday and Wednesday Performance are the metcon (B) only, because the POLP lift is done in WL.
Endurance is 3 sessions (Josh's choice): Row S1 Tue PM, Run Fri, easy Row S2 after Sat WL. Row S3 is dropped so Sunday stays a full rest day. Rowing paces come off the 19:19 5k (1:55.9/500m).
No pressing block yet. The press is failing at 52 and the shoulder is niggly, so Thursday's strict HSPU is this week's extra pressing.
POLP front squat isn't programmed this week. Saturday's pause front squat (WL) covers it.
